evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Yet delegation helps only when task allocation and subtask execution are coordinated: the main agent must issue useful subtasks, while subagents must return reliable evidence.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A training-time rubric evaluates the research utility of each subagent report and gates its inherited team advantage, while final-answer correctness remains the only team reward; no token, step, or speedup reward is used.
